target_definition: raw weekly log return (continuous).  Chosen over classification or ordinal because: (a) preserves magnitude information for Day 4 portfolio construction, (b) natural fit for Rank IC evaluation (we rank predictions, not binarize them), (c) simpler — fewer moving parts than triple-barrier labels.

imputation.leakage_prevention: all imputation uses only data on or before the date being filled — naturally enforced by Friday-to-Friday alignment

prices.method: leave NaN — ticker enters cross-section on first valid date

trends.mechanism: MNAR-adjacent (zeros = genuinely low interest, structural zeros recoded)
trends.method: zeros treated as real signal; structural pre-listing zeros replaced with NaN
trends.caveat: Treating genuine search-interest zeros as signal is a modeling assumption — there is no way to distinguish 'nobody searched' from 'data not collected' in the raw Trends index.

winsorize_standardize.method: per-date winsorization at p0.01-p0.99, percentile-rank standardization, sector-neutralized
winsorize_standardize.standardization: percentile-rank (rank-based → natural fit for Rank IC)
